definition.formula: Q = 19ⁿ, with Q states distributed as [ (Q-1)/3 , (Q-1)/3+1 , (Q-1)/3 ] across the ternary values.
definition.combined: Total expressive capacity = 19ⁿ × 2ᵐ when harmonics are active.

scaling.n: Controls granularity of the state space (depth).

constraint: n and m are non‑negative integers. For a closed Factor, the distribution of states must respect the ternary balance.
